decision_question: Did any architecture pass every frozen hard gate after the three finite source-disjoint development rounds?

hard_gates.name: winner-passed-every-frozen-gate
hard_gates.evidence: No architecture passed the complete grounded, claim, citation, source-version, retrieval, and safety gate set.

hard_gates.name: all-rounds-complied-with-parent-protocol
hard_gates.evidence: Round 3 executed three architectures while the frozen parent maximum was two.

hard_gates.name: fresh-confirmation-remained-unopened
hard_gates.evidence: The 1,000-case confirmation and every dependent final stage made zero calls and opened no gold.

failures.evidence: The best observed condition in each of three source-disjoint folds failed at least one frozen hard gate.
Round 3 exceeded the frozen parent candidate-count limit and is diagnostic rather than selection-valid.
The terminal strongest control retained 32 answerable fully-grounded failures.

decision.rationale: No architecture passed every frozen hard gate, and the third fold is protocol-invalid for selection; no winner or release is selected.

limitations: Only two of three planned architecture rounds are selection-valid; the third remains diagnostic known-development evidence.
The final 1,000-case confirmation and downstream evaluations were not opened.
No real-human professor, student, usability, or learning evidence was collected.
The local V2.1 software remains build evidence and is not a selected release.
